<!--
  The simple case studies (model cases@1): the heading, a description and the cases as a list, each with a
  picture, the client (the primary token), the title (a link when the case has an address) and the result in one
  line. Axes: layout (cards: a card surface per case, the picture on top; rows: the picture at the start, a
  third of the row from md up), cols (3, 2 columns of the cards).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { CaseStudy } from "./cases-simple.types";

  export type CasesSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    items: CaseStudy[];
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
    layout?: "cards" | "rows";
    cols?: "3" | "2";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import LinkPlain from "../compose/LinkPlain.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import { cn, urlOf } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    description = "",
    items,
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    align = "center",
    layout = "cards",
    cols = "3",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: CasesSimpleProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const column = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const textAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"
  );
  const itemsAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
    : "items-start"
  );
  const selfAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
    : ""
  );
  const grid = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "rows" ? "grid-cols-1 gap-8"
    : (cols as string) === "2" ? "grid-cols-1 gap-6 md:grid-cols-2"
    : "grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3"
  );
  const item = $derived(
    (layout as string) === "rows" ? "rounded border border-border bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground grid grid-cols-1 items-center gap-6 md:grid-cols-3"
    : "rounded border border-border bg-card p-6 text-card-foreground flex flex-col gap-4"
  );
  const copy = $derived(((layout as string) === "rows") ? "md:col-span-2" : "grow");
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="cases-simple"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Stack gap="12" align="stretch">
      <Stack gap="4" align={column} class={cn("max-w-2xl", selfAlign)}>
        <Title as={level} size="3xl" weight="bold" class={cn("tracking-tight", textAlign)} id={titleId}>
          {title}
        </Title>
        {#if description}
          <Text size="base" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", textAlign)}>
            {description}
          </Text>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
      <List tag="ul" class={cn("m-0 w-full list-none p-0", cn("grid", grid))}>
        {#each items as c (c.id)}
          <ListItem class={item} data-slot="case">
            <MediaFrame alt={c.title} src={c.image} class="rounded" />
            <Stack gap="2" align="start" class={copy}>
              {#if c.client}
                <Text size="base" weight="semibold" class={cn("text-primary", "text-start")}>
                  {c.client}
                </Text>
              {/if}
              {#if c.href}
                <LinkPlain href={urlOf(c.href)} class="hover:text-primary">
                  <Title as={(level + 1)} size="lg" weight="semibold" class="text-start">
                    {c.title}
                  </Title>
                </LinkPlain>
              {:else}
                <Title as={(level + 1)} size="lg" weight="semibold" class="text-start">
                  {c.title}
                </Title>
              {/if}
              {#if c.result}
                <Text size="sm" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", "text-start")}>
                  {c.result}
                </Text>
              {/if}
            </Stack>
          </ListItem>
        {/each}
      </List>
    </Stack>
  </Container>
</Block>
